retainedGeometryEvidence.scope: Every other service entry, including all 269 ECT render/roof/collision files and manifest, is byte-identical to dev.19. Renderer, shaders, textures and collision classes are unchanged. Existing collision migration v23 remains.

retainedRendererEvidence.scope: Detailed night, motion and lifecycle evidence remains specific to dev.16. Current full-route shadow/reflection checks are fresh on this artifact; no new claim of a full lifecycle rerun.

qualifications: Flight frames use settled spectator teleports through the relevant heights; they are sampled transitions, not a continuous flight recording.
FPS values are observational samples from separate runs, not a controlled performance benchmark.
The older courtyard report omits rendererJar; its fresh timestamp and the frozen run tie it to the same artifact as the other reports.
limitations: Roof equipment and facade details remain approximate; existing imagery contains baked vehicles and shadows.
Untreated neighbouring buildings, ground margins and landscaping still need work.
